Record Class DiscoveredModel

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.github.copilot.generated.rpc.DiscoveredModel
@CopilotExperimental @Generated("copilot-sdk-codegen") public record DiscoveredModel(String id, String name, ModelProviderProvenance provenance, String digest, OffsetDateTime modifiedAt, Long sizeBytes, ModelArtifactDetails details, ModelCapabilities capabilities, List<ModelProviderWarning> warnings) extends Record
A model offered for agent conversations. Missing capability metadata does not disqualify a candidate. Models known to be incompatible, such as embedding-only models, are excluded by the adapter.
Since:
